news.title: Apple beats Q3 estimates as iPhone sales surge, services hit record
news.summary: Cupertino-based Apple reported quarterly revenue of $94.8B, beating analyst estimates of $92.3B. iPhone sales grew 6.4% YoY, while services segment reached all-time high of $24.2B.

news.title: Apple announces $110B share buyback program, dividend hike
news.summary: Apple's board authorized an additional $110B share repurchase program, the largest in corporate history. The company also raised its quarterly dividend by 4%.

news.title: Apple Vision Pro 2 launch delayed amid production issues, sources say
news.summary: Apple's next-generation mixed reality headset has been delayed by at least three months due to supply chain constraints on micro-OLED displays, according to people familiar with the matter.

news.title: NVIDIA's new Blackwell Ultra chips in tight supply, customers scramble
news.summary: NVIDIA's latest AI accelerator chips are facing allocation shortages, with major cloud providers competing for limited inventory. Hyperscaler orders reportedly exceed supply by 3x.

news.title: NVIDIA data center revenue beats estimates, raises full-year guidance
news.summary: NVIDIA reported data center revenue of $32.6B, beating consensus of $30.1B. The company raised full-year revenue guidance, citing 'unprecedented' AI demand.

news.title: U.S. weighs new export curbs on NVIDIA's China-specific AI chips
news.summary: The Commerce Department is reportedly considering expanding restrictions on AI chip exports, targeting even the lower-spec China-specific variants of NVIDIA's products.

news.title: Microsoft Azure growth accelerates, AI services drive 35% revenue jump
news.summary: Microsoft's cloud segment Azure posted 35% YoY growth, driven by surging demand for Azure OpenAI Service and AI-powered enterprise tools. Capital expenditure rose to $28B.

news.title: Microsoft wins $20B Pentagon cloud contract, expands government AI
news.summary: The Department of Defense awarded Microsoft a multi-year cloud and AI services contract valued at up to $20B, cementing Azure's position in the federal market.

news.title: Google parent Alphabet to buy back $70B in stock, first-ever dividend declared
news.summary: Alphabet announced its first-ever quarterly cash dividend of $0.20/share alongside a $70B share repurchase authorization. The move signals confidence in cash flow generation.

news.title: DOJ antitrust case: Google search monopoly trial begins next month
news.summary: The Department of Justice's landmark antitrust case against Google's search business is scheduled to begin trial next month. The case could result in structural remedies.

news.title: Meta's Reality Labs posts smaller-than-expected loss, stock surges
news.summary: Meta's metaverse division reported a Q3 operating loss of $8.2B, narrower than analyst estimates of $9.5B. Shares rose 5% in extended trading on the news.

news.title: Meta unveils new AI-powered advertising tools, targets SMB market
news.summary: Meta announced a suite of generative AI tools for small businesses to create ads automatically. The launch is part of CEO's strategy to dominate AI-driven advertising.

news.title: Tesla cuts prices in China again amid weak demand, shares slide
news.summary: Tesla reduced Model Y and Model 3 prices in China by 4-6%, the third cut this quarter. The move signals persistent demand weakness and increased competition from BYD.

news.title: Tesla Cybertruck production halted for one week over quality issues
news.summary: Tesla paused Cybertruck production at its Texas Gigafactory for one week to address panel gap and fitment issues, according to internal communications.

news.title: Tesla's robotaxi launch postponed to Q2 2027, Musk confirms
news.summary: Elon Musk confirmed that the company's robotaxi service launch will be delayed to the second quarter of 2027, citing regulatory hurdles and additional safety testing requirements.

news.title: Amazon AWS growth re-accelerates, AI workloads drive margin expansion
news.summary: AWS posted 19% YoY revenue growth in Q3, the strongest in seven quarters. Operating margin expanded to 36.5% as AI workloads increased efficiency.

news.title: Amazon to invest $15B in data center expansion in Northern Virginia
news.summary: Amazon Web Services announced a $15B investment to expand its data center footprint in Loudoun County, Virginia, creating 5,000 new jobs.

news.title: Eli Lilly's GLP-1 drug Mounjaro shows strong heart benefits in late-stage trial
news.summary: Eli Lilly's blockbuster weight-loss drug Mounjaro demonstrated significant cardiovascular benefits in a Phase 3 trial, potentially expanding the addressable market.

news.title: Eli Lilly raises full-year guidance on GLP-1 demand, stock hits record
news.summary: Eli Lilly raised its full-year revenue guidance for the second time this year, citing stronger-than-expected demand for its GLP-1 drugs Zepbound and Mounjaro.

news.title: UnitedHealth raises dividend, beats Q3 earnings estimates
news.summary: UnitedHealth Group reported Q3 adjusted EPS of $7.15, beating consensus of $6.82. The company raised its quarterly dividend by 10%.

news.title: UnitedHealth faces DOJ investigation into Medicare billing practices
news.summary: The Department of Justice has opened a civil investigation into UnitedHealth's Medicare Advantage billing practices, according to people familiar with the matter.

news.title: Johnson & Johnson settles talc lawsuits for $8B, lawsuit stock jumps
news.summary: J&J agreed to pay $8B to settle thousands of lawsuits alleging its talc products caused cancer. The settlement removes a major overhang on the stock.

news.title: JPMorgan beats Q3 estimates, lifts 2026 NII guidance to record
news.summary: JPMorgan Chase reported Q3 EPS of $5.20, beating consensus of $4.85. CEO Jamie Dimon raised full-year net interest income guidance to a new record.

news.title: JPMorgan's Dimon warns of 'storm clouds' over U.S. economy
news.summary: JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon cautioned about geopolitical risks and inflation, saying the U.S. economy faces 'more storm clouds' than at any time in the past decade.

news.title: Visa reports strong Q4 results, cross-border volume surges 18%
news.summary: Visa reported Q4 net revenue of $9.2B, with cross-border payment volumes jumping 18% YoY. The company authorized a new $10B share repurchase program.

news.title: Bank of America beats Q3 estimates on strong NII, provisions fall
news.summary: Bank of America reported Q3 EPS of $0.94, beating consensus of $0.85. Net interest income rose 4% YoY, while credit provisions declined from year-ago levels.

news.title: Walmart reports strong Q3, raises full-year guidance on grocery share gains
news.summary: Walmart reported Q3 comp sales growth of 5.8%, the strongest in five years. The retailer raised full-year EPS guidance as it gains share in grocery.

news.title: Walmart invests $3B in automation, expands use of AI in fulfillment centers
news.summary: Walmart announced a $3B investment to expand automation across its U.S. fulfillment network, including AI-powered inventory management systems.

news.title: McDonald's same-store sales beat estimates, traffic rebounds in U.S.
news.summary: McDonald's reported Q3 global same-store sales of 4.2%, beating consensus of 3.5%. U.S. traffic returned to positive territory for the first time in six quarters.

news.title: Starbucks same-store sales miss, China demand remains weak
news.summary: Starbucks reported Q4 same-store sales of 2.1%, missing consensus of 3.5%. China comparable sales declined 8% as competition with local chains intensifies.

news.title: ExxonMobil beats Q3 earnings on strong refining margins, production up
news.summary: ExxonMobil reported Q3 EPS of $2.06, beating consensus of $1.92. Refining margins surged on global supply tightness, while production rose 6% YoY.

news.title: ExxonMobil's $60B Pioneer acquisition receives final regulatory approval
news.summary: ExxonMobil's $60B acquisition of Pioneer Natural Resources received final approval from U.S. regulators. The deal is expected to close by year-end.

news.title: Caterpillar cuts full-year guidance on weak demand, China sales plunge
news.summary: Caterpillar reduced its full-year revenue guidance, citing weaker-than-expected construction equipment demand. Sales in China declined 22% YoY.

news.title: Caterpillar announces $4B share buyback despite earnings miss
news.summary: Caterpillar announced a new $4B share repurchase program despite missing Q3 earnings estimates, signaling confidence in long-term cash generation.

news.title: AMD's MI350 AI chip wins major hyperscaler order, stock rallies
news.summary: AMD announced a multi-billion-dollar AI chip order from a top-tier cloud provider for its MI350 accelerators. Shares surged 12% in pre-market.

news.title: Broadcom cuts full-year revenue forecast on AI demand weakness
news.summary: Broadcom lowered its full-year AI revenue forecast, citing 'softer than expected' demand from one of its hyperscaler customers. Shares fell 6%.

news.title: Oracle's cloud revenue beats estimates, raises subscription outlook
news.summary: Oracle reported Q2 cloud infrastructure revenue of $2.4B, beating consensus. The company raised its full-year OCI subscription outlook.

news.title: Salesforce reports strong Q3, AI agents drive new bookings
news.summary: Salesforce reported Q3 revenue of $9.3B, beating estimates. The company's AI agent platform, Agentforce, drove over $1B in new bookings.

news.title: Netflix subscriber additions beat, ad-tier drives growth
news.summary: Netflix added 14.2M subscribers in Q3, beating consensus of 11.5M. The ad-supported tier now accounts for 35% of new sign-ups in the U.S.

news.title: AT&T beats Q3 estimates on wireless postpaid growth, fiber expansion
news.summary: AT&T reported Q3 EPS of $0.60, beating consensus. The company added 415K postpaid phone subscribers and expanded fiber to 1.2M new locations.

news.title: Home Depot beats Q3 estimates, raises full-year outlook
news.summary: Home Depot reported Q3 comp sales of 2.8%, beating estimates. The retailer raised its full-year EPS guidance as the housing market stabilizes.

news.title: Coca-Cola reports solid Q3, raises full-year organic revenue outlook
news.summary: Coca-Cola reported Q3 organic revenue growth of 5.1%, with pricing actions offsetting volume softness in Latin America. The company raised full-year guidance.
